capacity_gross_kwh.notes: 2012 spec list: "31 kWh usable capacity (total rating of 33 kWh)". Wikipedia calls the pack "31 kWh".

chemistry.notes: LiFePO4 (cells via Lishen/LIO Energy Systems per Wikipedia Coda Automotive).

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Wikipedia mentions only an "active thermal management system" for range and durability; no battery preconditioning feature and no DC fast charging described for the 2012-2013 car. Not confirmed by an owner's manual. No maker launch of battery preconditioning could be cited; moot for a car with no DC port (dc_max_kw 0), so owner decision requested. Spec list: "active thermal management for battery" (air cooling and heating) only.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: 333 V pack (spec list; NHTSA data also says a 333-volt pack, 385 V max).

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Wikipedia describes only a 6.6 kW on-board charger and a level-two (220 V) charge station; no DC fast charging is mentioned (repo model note also says none).

ac_max_kw.notes: 6.6 kW / 240 VAC on-board charger (1.3 kW at 110 V).
